questions.stem_html: Afoxun <small style="font-variant: small-caps">L</small>-gúlósa með NaBH<sub>4</sub> leiðir til sama alditóls (<small style="font-variant: small-caps">D</small>-glúkitóls) og afoxun <small style="font-variant: small-caps">D</small>-glúkósa. Útskýrðu.

collaborator_solutions.content_html: −CHO endi <small style="font-variant: small-caps">L</small>-gúlósa samsvarar −CH<sub>2</sub>OH enda <small style="font-variant: small-caps">D</small>-glúkósa eftir afoxun.
